# hulistmi.ai

## HTTP API

- Fetch guide Markdown: `GET /consumer/{en|cn}/doc/harmonyos-guides/<path>`
- Fetch reference Markdown: `GET /consumer/{en|cn}/doc/harmonyos-references/<path>`
- Fetch release notes Markdown: `GET /consumer/{en|cn}/doc/harmonyos-releases/<path>`
- Fetch design Markdown: `GET /consumer/{en|cn}/doc/design-guides/<path>`
- Fetch best-practices Markdown: `GET /consumer/{en|cn}/doc/best-practices/<path>`
- Fetch FAQs Markdown: `GET /consumer/{en|cn}/doc/harmonyos-faqs/<path>`
- Search: `GET /search?q=<query>&language=en|cn`
- Catalog: `GET /catalog?catalogName=<name>&language=en|cn` (any of: harmonyos-guides, harmonyos-references, harmonyos-releases, design-guides, best-practices, harmonyos-faqs)

## MCP Integration

- Endpoint: `{{ORIGIN}}/mcp`
- WebMCP manifest: `{{ORIGIN}}/webmcp/manifest.json`
- Tools: `searchHarmonyOSDocumentation`, `fetchHarmonyOSDocumentation`, `fetchHarmonyOSCatalog`

## CLI

- Package: `@hulistmi/hulistmi`
- Binary: `hulistmi`

- Skill: `{{ORIGIN}}/SKILL.md`

hulistmi.ai is unofficial, on-demand, transient, not an archive, not a bulk mirror, not a redistribution channel, and not a bypass mechanism for Huawei access controls.{{HOSTED_NOTE}}
